node.statement: The rectangular-product application is legitimate at every n: node 1.2 puts both factors in S_{P_n}, and lem-compcb-amplified-compression identifies this with M_n tensor S_P; hence they form the compatible amplified rectangular pair P_n,P_n,P_n required by lem-compcb-rectangular-product. Its threshold is independent of n.
